title: Ambiguous SKU normalization lab journal
content:
Notes-to-self / lab journal for ambiguous SKU normalization (personal scratchpad).

Background: we keep getting low inter-annotator agreement on SKU-like tokens in retail feeds. Short-term need: a small set of deterministic heuristics to reduce noise for evals and to bootstrap a model-assisted cleanup pipeline. Long-term: fold rules into the sampling/quality checks.

Common failure modes observed (examples from prod-ish samples):
- Embedded vendor codes: "PRD-XL_23-ACME" -> is this single SKU or SKU+vendor? Current labelers split.
- Hyphen vs slash vs space: "SKU-1234/56" vs "SKU 1234 56". Tokenizer splits unpredictably.
- Human-entered ranges: "100-102" (three SKUs?) Often treated as one.
- Leading zeros and checksum-like suffixes: "0009876-3" vs canonical "9876".
- Locale numerics: "1.234,56-XL" (EU style), appears in international feeds.
- OCR artifacts: "S K U 123" or accidental soft hyphens.

Quick heuristics I prototyped (for triage stage):
1) Normal form: uppercase, collapse repeated separators to single '-', strip common vendor tokens (ACME, MFG:, V-). Keep alpha-numeric runs.
2) Range expansion flag: if pattern matches "\d+-\d+" then mark as RANGE and emit sample to microbatch for adjudication. Do not auto-split unless both endpoints < 10 apart and product family matches.
3) Leading zeros: if length difference only due to leading zeros and core digits match other SKUs in same vendor cluster => canonicalize by trimming zeros and add meta-tag "trimmed-leading-zeros".
4) OCR/spacing repairs: remove isolated single-letter spaces if length >=6 and letters/digits ratio > 0.6.
5) Locale numbers: detect presence of comma+period patterns and normalize digits-only segments.

Regex sketches (very rough):
- vendor-strip: (?i)^(?:ACME|MFG:|V-)
- range-detect: ^(\d{2,6})-(\d{1,6})(?:-(?:.*))?$
- spaced-token-repair: (?<=\b)([A-Z](?:\s+[A-Z])+)(?=\b)

Adjudication protocol for ambiguous cases (micro-adjudication flow):
- If heuristic returns CLEAR -> accept and annotate canonical form + evidence note (example neighbour SKUs).
- If heuristic returns RANGE or UNCERTAIN -> push to 3-person adjudication queue. Provide context: title, nearby SKUs, vendor.
- If OCR artifact detected -> try gentle repair + tag "ocr-suspect" and sample 5% to human review.

Sampling & metrics to track:
- pre/post normalization token counts reduction
- fraction of canonicalized tokens that collide with different product ids (FP rate)
- inter-annotator agreement on adjudicated microbatches (target > 0.8)
- precision of range expansion (target > 0.9 before auto-splitting)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should vendor-stripping be opt-in per customer? Some customers include vendor code inside SKU by intent. Need a metadata flag on feed source.
- How to represent multi-SKU ranges in downstream product catalog (single field vs produce multiple items)? Ask product for UI expectations (ticket: JIRA-ML-4321).
- Edge case: tokens like "12A-RED-EXP" (color/variant encoded). If downstream cares about color, we must preserve variant suffix as separate attribute rather than canonicalizing away. Need mapping table per merchant.
- Can we get a small ground-truth set from solutions-eng for top 30 merchants? Reach out to Sofia to scope.

Mini-adjudication examples (my notes from session 2026-02-12):
- Input: "ACME-000123-XL" -> Proposed canonical "123-XL"; adjudicators: 2/3 accept, reason: vendor token removed, keep size suffix.
- Input: "100-102" (context: product family 'bolt-kit') -> adjudicators: split into 100,101,102 (explicitly annotated) because doc shows quantity list.
- Input: "S K U 5 6 7" (OCR) -> repaired to "SKU567" but flagged "ocr-suspect"; action: sample to human review.

Notes to implementor (dev handoff):
- Put heuristics into transform pipeline as a small pluggable module. Use feature flag per customer.
- Export meta-tags alongside canonical SKU so downstream can decide (e.g., "trimmed-leading-zeros", "ocr-suspect", "range-expanded").
- Add unit tests with the adjudication examples above and at least 50 synthetic perturbations.

Quick log of slack/refs: 
- slack thread: #labeling-sku-cleanup (see thread ts 1700452345)
- ticket: JIRA-ML-4321 (linked)
- convo with solutions: Sofia A. -> follow-up to request merchant sample list

Final micro-plan (next steps):
- Draft a small decision rubric (one-pager) for labelers to use in micro-adjudication (by end of week).
- Build 300-sample microbatch for initial adjudication (Liam + 2 labelers).
- Prototype transform + tests (Ethan) and run on slice of production feed.

Random thoughts: maybe use a small fuzzy-join on vendor clusters to detect when vendor code is really part of SKU vs annotation noise. Worth a lightweight embedding-based lookup for merchant clusters later.

---
End of scratchpad. Will iterate and move clean version to shared_drives once rules stabilize.
